title: MobileNeTTT: a Lightweight DNN-based Time-To-Transit Estimator for Visual Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29454v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-to-Transit (TTT) is a perceptual cue, proxy for depth, that can be computed in the visual cortex, allowing animals to estimate the time remaining to move past features in the environment. We show how TTT can be estimated and used for bio-inspired navigation of a mobile robot equipped with a monocular camera. The paper describes a lightweight neural network estimation method, named MobileNeTTT, that (1) uses the full field of view and provides a rich array of visual feature TTT estimates; (2) is relatively insensitive to camera rotation; and (3) automatically adjusts to the geometry of the path and the presence of obstacles. Because TTT is a coarse visual cue, it is far simpler to use for robot navigation than current large visual depth foundation models. Our navigation model uses a 1.95M-parameter network that is two to three orders of magnitude smaller than well-known large vision foundation models, making it able to run in real

translated_title: MobileNeTTT：一种用于视觉导航的基于轻量级深度神经网络的穿越时间估计器
translated_abstract: 穿越时间是一种知觉线索，是深度的代理指标，可以在视觉皮层中计算得出，使动物能够估计越过环境中特征所需的剩余时间。我们展示了如何估计TTT并将其用于配备单目摄像头的移动机器人的仿生导航。该论文描述了一种轻量级神经网络估计方法，名为MobileNeTTT，它（1）利用整个视野并提供丰富的视觉特征TTT估计；（2）对相机旋转相对不敏感；（3）能够自动适应路径的几何形状和障碍物的存在。由于TTT是一种粗略的视觉线索，与当前大型视觉深度基础模型相比，它用于机器人导航要简单得多。我们的导航模型使用了一个仅有195万参数的网络，比知名的大型视觉基础模型小两到三个数量级，使其能够实时运行。
tldr: 本文提出MobileNeTTT，一种仅195万参数的轻量级神经网络，通过估计仿生知觉线索“穿越时间”（TTT）实现单目移动机器人的实时视觉导航，其模型规模比大型视觉基础模型小两到三个数量级。
